content:
Following last week’s livestream, when Labrinth composed and recorded a song overnight at Apple Tower Theatre in Los Angeles on the new touchscreen MacBook Pro, the single is now available on Apple Music. Here are the details.

’I can literally touch my project now’

Last Wednesday evening, singer-songwriter Labrinth transformed Apple Tower Theatre in Downtown Los Angeles into his private studio as he composed a song from scratch using Logic Pro 13 on the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display.

The entire session was livestreamed on his YouTube channel, with Labrinth also answering questions from fans along the way.

Now, the finished single, “Surrender,” is available on Apple Music, and subscribers can listen to it below:

Apple has also published a short video on its YouTube channel with highlights from the entire session, and you can watch it below:

The video description reads:

One song. In one night. Created live on the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display and Touch.

Multiplatinum artist Labrinth transformed Apple Tower Theatre into his personal studio for the night, experimenting with new ways of making music on the new MacBook Pro.

See how Touch opens up a world of creative possibilities in Logic Pro 13: shaping EQ envelopes, manipulating samples, tweaking Remix FX, and even playing keys right onscreen.

Apple Music requires an active subscription. You can sign up for $11.99 per month, with 1 month free, or as part of the Apple One bundle.
